versionwatch-check-now: Label of the button on [[Special:VersionWatch]] that runs a new check.
versionwatch-no-report: Shown on [[Special:VersionWatch]] when no check has run yet.
versionwatch-last-checked:
Shown above the report.

Parameters:
* $1 - date and time of the check
versionwatch-stale: Warning shown when the stored report is more than a week old.
versionwatch-attention:
Summary above the report.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of components that are outdated or no longer supported
versionwatch-attention-security:
Summary above the report when security updates are available.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of components that need attention
* $2 - number of those with security fixes
versionwatch-attention-none: Summary above the report when nothing is outdated or unsupported.
versionwatch-section-platform: Heading for the table with MediaWiki, PHP and the database server.
versionwatch-section-extensions:
Heading for the table of extensions.
{{Identical|Extension}}
versionwatch-section-skins:
Heading for the table of skins.
{{Identical|Skin}}
versionwatch-column-installed: Table column header for the installed version.
versionwatch-column-latest: Table column header for the latest available version or commit.
versionwatch-column-note:
Table column header for the explanation of the status.
{{Identical|Details}}
versionwatch-column-repository:
Table column header for where an extension or skin is looked up.
{{Identical|Repository}}
versionwatch-status-current: Status of a component that is up to date.
versionwatch-status-outdated: Status of a component for which a newer version or newer commits exist.
versionwatch-status-unsupported: Status of a component whose release branch has reached end of life.
versionwatch-status-unknown:
Status of a component that could not be checked. The details column explains why.
{{Identical|Unknown}}
versionwatch-status-skipped: Status of a component that the configuration excludes from checking.
versionwatch-status-security: Status of a component for which a newer version or newer changes include security fixes. Shown before all other statuses.
versionwatch-bundled-with:
Shown in parentheses after the commit of an extension or skin that has no git information of its own, so the commit was taken from the MediaWiki release it came with.

Parameters:
* $1 - MediaWiki version, such as 1.43.12
versionwatch-changes-show: Label to expand the list of newer upstream changes (commits) of an extension or skin.
versionwatch-changes-all: Link below the list of newer changes to the full list on the hosting service, such as Wikimedia Gerrit or GitHub.
versionwatch-download: Link to download the newer version of an extension or skin, such as from ExtensionDistributor on mediawiki.org or as a zip file from GitHub.
versionwatch-download-mediawiki:
Link to the MediaWiki download page.

Parameters:
* $1 - newest MediaWiki version on the installed branch, such as 1.43.13
versionwatch-repository-change:
Link text, shown in parentheses, to [[Special:VersionWatch]]/<name>, where the repository setting can be changed.
{{Identical|Change}}
versionwatch-repository-not-checked: Shown in the repository column for an extension or skin that is set not to be checked.
versionwatch-repository-invalid: Shown in the repository column when the setting on [[MediaWiki:VersionWatch.json]] cannot be understood.
versionwatch-repository-default-branch: Shown in parentheses after a GitHub repository that is compared against its default branch.
versionwatch-repository-part-of:
Shown in the repository column for a module that lives inside another extension.

Parameters:
* $1 - name of the containing extension
versionwatch-settings-title:
Page title of the form that changes where an extension or skin is looked up.

Parameters:
* $1 - extension or skin name
versionwatch-settings-intro:
Introduction above the form.

Parameters:
* $1 - extension or skin name
versionwatch-settings-not-installed:
Error shown when the subpage of [[Special:VersionWatch]] does not name an installed extension or skin.

Parameters:
* $1 - the name from the subpage
versionwatch-settings-part-of:
Error shown when trying to change the repository of a module that lives inside another extension.

Parameters:
* $1 - module name, such as ConfirmEdit/Turnstile
* $2 - name of the containing extension
versionwatch-settings-invalid: Warning above the form when the stored setting is invalid, for example after a manual edit.
versionwatch-settings-source: Label for the choice of hosting service.
versionwatch-settings-source-gerrit: Option for extensions hosted by Wikimedia, the default.
versionwatch-settings-source-github:
Option for extensions hosted on GitHub.
{{Identical|GitHub}}
versionwatch-settings-source-none: Option to exclude the extension or skin from checks, such as for local code without an upstream.
versionwatch-settings-path: Label for the repository path field.
versionwatch-settings-path-help:
Help for the repository path field.

Parameters:
* $1 - default Gerrit project path, such as mediawiki/extensions/Echo
versionwatch-settings-branch-help:
Help for the branch field.

Parameters:
* $1 - default branch, such as REL1_43
versionwatch-settings-github-required: Validation error for the repository field when GitHub is chosen.
versionwatch-settings-invalid-path: Validation error for the repository field.
versionwatch-settings-invalid-branch: Validation error for the branch field.
versionwatch-settings-summary:
Edit summary for the change to [[MediaWiki:VersionWatch.json]].

Parameters:
* $1 - extension or skin name
versionwatch-upgrade-heading:
Heading of the section about upgrading to the newest MediaWiki release.

Parameters:
* $1 - newest MediaWiki version, such as 1.46.3
versionwatch-upgrade-intro:
Introduction to the upgrade section.

Parameters:
* $1 - newest MediaWiki version
versionwatch-upgrade-until:
Follows versionwatch-upgrade-intro.

Parameters:
* $1 - end of support date
versionwatch-upgrade-lts-until:
Follows versionwatch-upgrade-intro for a long-term support release.

Parameters:
* $1 - end of support date
versionwatch-upgrade-shorter-support:
Shown when the newest MediaWiki release is supported for a shorter time than the installed one, such as when moving from a long-term support release.

Parameters:
* $1 - end of support date of the installed release
versionwatch-upgrade-php-ok:
Follows the support date when this server's PHP version is supported.

Parameters:
* $1 - supported PHP versions, such as ">=8.3.0"
* $2 - PHP version of this server
versionwatch-upgrade-php-missing:
Follows the support date when this server's PHP version is too old.

Parameters:
* $1 - supported PHP versions, such as ">=8.3.0"
* $2 - PHP version of this server
versionwatch-upgrade-blocking:
Summary of the upgrade section.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of extensions and skins that are not maintained for or not compatible with the newer release
* $2 - newest MediaWiki version
versionwatch-upgrade-none-blocking:
Summary of the upgrade section when nothing blocks the upgrade.

Parameters:
* $1 - always 0, unused
* $2 - newest MediaWiki version
versionwatch-upgrade-status-ready:
Upgrade status: a version for the newer MediaWiki release exists.
{{Identical|Ready}}
versionwatch-upgrade-status-bundled: Upgrade status: the extension comes with the newer MediaWiki release.
versionwatch-upgrade-status-no-branch: Upgrade status: there is no version of the extension for the newer MediaWiki release.
versionwatch-upgrade-status-incompatible: Upgrade status: the version for the newer MediaWiki release needs something this server does not have.
versionwatch-upgrade-status-unknown:
Upgrade status: could not be determined.
{{Identical|Unknown}}
versionwatch-upgrade-status-skipped:
Upgrade status: the extension is set not to be checked.
{{Identical|Skipped}}
versionwatch-upgrade-note-ready:
Shown when an extension has a version for the newer MediaWiki release.

Parameters:
* $1 - branch name, such as REL1_46
versionwatch-upgrade-note-bundled:
Shown when an extension is part of the newer MediaWiki release's download.

Parameters:
* $1 - MediaWiki version
versionwatch-upgrade-note-no-branch:
Shown when an extension has no release branch for the newer MediaWiki release.

Parameters:
* $1 - branch name, such as REL1_46
* $2 - MediaWiki version
versionwatch-upgrade-note-no-manifest:
Shown when the branch an extension is compared with has no manifest file.

Parameters:
* $1 - extension.json or skin.json
* $2 - branch name
versionwatch-upgrade-note-requires:
Shown when the version of an extension for the newer MediaWiki release has requirements this server does not meet.

Parameters:
* $1 - PHP or MediaWiki
* $2 - version constraint, such as ">= 1.47"
* $3 - installed version
echo-category-title-versionwatch:
Title of the notification preference for update notifications from [[Special:VersionWatch]].

Parameters:
* $1 - number of notifications, for PLURAL
notification-header-versionwatch-update:
Header of the notification about available updates.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of components with a new update
* $2 - comma-separated list of their names, possibly not all
* $3 - number of components not listed in $2
notification-header-versionwatch-update-:
Header of the notification when updates include security fixes.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of components with a new security update
* $2 - comma-separated list of their names, possibly not all
* $3 - number of components not listed in $2
notification-link-text-versionwatch-upda: Label of the link in the notification to [[Special:VersionWatch]].
versionwatch-note-request-failed:
Parameters:
* $1 - host name, such as gerrit.wikimedia.org
* $2 - error, such as "HTTP 500" or a connection error from cURL
versionwatch-note-unknown-product: Shown for a database server type that has no release data.
versionwatch-note-eol: Shown when a release branch is unsupported but no end date is known.
versionwatch-note-commits-behind:
Shown when the upstream branch has changes (commits) that the installed copy does not have.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of changes
* $2 - branch name, such as REL1_43
versionwatch-note-security-changes:
Shown when the newer upstream changes include security fixes.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of newer changes
* $2 - branch name, such as REL1_43
* $3 - number of security fixes among them
versionwatch-note-core-security:
Shown when a newer MediaWiki release on the installed branch fixes security issues.

Parameters:
* $1 - newer MediaWiki version, such as 1.43.13
* $2 - number of security fixes
versionwatch-note-requires:
Warning shown when the newer version of an extension or skin needs a newer version of PHP or MediaWiki than this wiki has.

Parameters:
* $1 - PHP or MediaWiki
* $2 - version constraint from the extension, such as ">= 8.4"
* $3 - installed version, such as 8.3.37
versionwatch-note-only-ignored-commits:
Shown when all newer changes (commits) are from ignored authors, such as the translation bot, or only change files used for development, such as linter configuration and tests.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of changes
versionwatch-note-no-branch:
Parameters:
* $1 - branch name, such as REL1_43
versionwatch-note-invalid-setting: Shown when the entry for an extension or skin on the settings page cannot be understood, for example after a manual edit.
versionwatch-note-part-of:
Shown for a module that lives inside another extension, such as ConfirmEdit/Turnstile. Its status is that of the containing extension.

Parameters:
* $1 - name of the containing extension
versionwatch-note-commit-not-found:
Shown when the commit the installed copy was made from does not exist in the upstream repository.

Parameters:
* $1 - abbreviated commit hash, such as 013c942
versionwatch-note-no-version: Shown for an extension or skin that has no git information, is not part of the MediaWiki release, and has no version number.
versionwatch-note-no-upstream-version: Shown when the upstream extension.json or skin.json has no version to compare with.
